audience: new DTC sellers confused by multi-state nexus
disclosure_rule: none in cold reply (no product mentioned); seller interest stated only if toolkit mentioned on follow-up
draft: Short answer: home state yes (physical presence = automatic nexus), other states only when you cross their economic thresholds. The part most new sellers miss: several states measure trailing 12 months, not calendar year, so a midyear crossing never shows on a Jan-Dec tally. Keep one running log per state, separate marketplace sales from direct (some states count marketplace toward your threshold even though the marketplace remits), and check the trailing total monthly. I wrote the full rolling-12-month method up here if useful: https://galaxyaek7-del.github.io/openclaw-factory/customer_site/guide-sales-tax-nexus-rolling-method.html (free guide, not tax advice — verify thresholds with each state).
